item: 8.11 side question (/btw): a question asked in the side panel goes out as a `side` bridge message with the panel's history, the answer renders in the panel as markdown, and NOTHING reaches the log
branch: 60-composer.js submit() `/btw` native branch → 67-side.js sideOpen/sideAsk/sideAnswer; 70-events.js `__side` + `__clear` reset; 30-menus.js Escape rung; 65-slash.js CMD_LOCAL
provenance: The CLI frames are MEASURED, verbatim from a live probe on 2.1.251 (2026-08-29, tools/ probe in the journal): `system/control_request_progress{request_id,status:'started',uuid,session_id}` precedes every answer, and the control_response carries {response, synthetic:false}; a follow-up with `history:[{question,response}]` was answered in context; nothing was written to the project's transcript dir. `__side` is OURS (ChatPanel's translation of that control_response: {id, response|null, synthetic} or {id, error}) — self-consistency evidence for the page half; the Kotlin half is verified live (§17 MT-7.9). The `side` bridge payload is asserted through a taped window.__bridge (restored in the last step), so nothing here asks the sandbox's CLI anything. The no-answer line for response:null follows the CLI's own contract (askSideQuestion returns null → VS Code shows the same sentence). NEGATIVE CONTROL: run against the sandbox still serving the pre-feature webview (no #sidePanel, no /btw branch) — RUN 2026-08-29, result in the journal; every DISCRIMINATING assert must fail there, the GUARDs (log untouched) pass either way, which is why the guards alone would be vacuous. ROW IDS: the counter is page-lifetime monotonic (never reset, so a late answer for an old row can never land on a new one), which is why every __side frame here takes its id FROM THE TAPE rather than a literal — the first full-harness pass after the fixture was written passed with sq1/sq2, the second failed with sq5/sq6 (2026-08-29). CENTRING CONTROL 2026-08-29: the centre-delta assert was run against the sandbox still serving the pre-centring chat.css (the free pre-fix build) — result in the journal; it reads -61 there at the panel's 869px width and 0 after the restart.
